title: checklist coverage: v18.5.0 sweep surfaces with no checklist item (writeRequiresMasterRead, renamedFrom holder carry, cross-object where, and others)
body:
domain:devx#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQTVjryTSkqydKVS6z

Carries the new-coverage rows of #33761 (the v18.5.0 release test sweep anchor): surfaces the sweep drove that no checklist item covers. This is `checklist-author` work (new items), not accuracy. Filing gate ①: the follow-up owed by in-flight work. Ledger: anchor comment 6896511848 (read at `origin/main` `895783a1`). ⛔ Not a claim.

## Scope

- Rows of ledger 6896511848: 11, 12, 15, 16, 101, 196, 209. Examples: row 11, the `writeRequiresMasterRead` opt-in of #33250 (403/404 split); row 12, the `renamedFrom` holder carry of #33238 (no item exists); row 15, the #33181 files and #33512's one-hop cross-object `where`.
- New items in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/*.json` by the `checklist-author` skill's rules, one per uncovered surface, each with its source citations and an automated ref where a pin exists.
- Serial: after the batch cards that touch the same area files merge.

## Acceptance

- Each row has a new item, or a reading that an existing item already covers it.
- `check:platform-checklist` passes.

Priority p2 (coverage growth, not release evidence).
